retryQueue.reason: The free-plan daily video-generation quota rejected the first planned eight-second visual clip before any video file was created.
retryQueue.retryCondition: Use an available video-generation quota or an owner-enabled plan, then restart at the video-generation gate without repeating verified research, script, or narration work.
retryQueue.preservationRule: Retain the research draft, production blueprint, generated narration, and visual-reference request. Do not count the reel as completed, failed, Drive-uploaded, or publicly published.

resolvedArtifactRevisions.issue: Legacy burned-in caption treatment remained visually conflicting with the corrected external caption layer.
resolvedArtifactRevisions.resolution: Retained the failed local revision and produced a subsequent opaque caption-safe revision; no Drive file was replaced.

resolvedArtifactRevisions.issue: The lower portion of the legacy caption field remained visible in visual QA.
resolvedArtifactRevisions.resolution: Retained the failed local revision and produced V4 with full legacy-caption masking before upload.

queueRule: A Reel enters retryQueue only when it cannot pass an evidence, production, QA, or private-Drive verification gate after bounded diagnosis. Resolved local artifact revisions are retained for audit but do not inflate failed Reel counts.
